extraction.title: Exercise and the epigenome
extraction.subtitle: Time to edit some biological metaphors Not everything is in your DNA
extraction.summary: The article discusses the implications of epigenomic medicine, emphasizing how environmental factors can influence gene expression and challenge deterministic views of genetics. It highlights the potential for biotech advancements to improve health while also addressing the cultural misconceptions surrounding genetics.
